name: Muhammad Ishaq Khan
tagline: Software engineer building ProxiCall — a production Flutter super-app — alongside backbencher.cc, my AST-native code intelligence platform. Code merged into VS Code and Flutter.
about: I'm a software engineer based in Budapest and a Computer Science graduate of Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE). Right now I'm building ProxiCall — a production Flutter proximity super-app with Stripe Connect payments, geo-fencing, and 32-language auto-translation.

Alongside it I develop backbencher.cc, an AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes codebases into a queryable knowledge graph with 13 brain tools. I've contributed to VS Code (performance) and Flutter (security hardening), and my BSc thesis on OSINT-enhanced phishing detection reached 96.45% accuracy.

projects.name: backbencher.cc (bb)
projects.description: My primary project — an open-core AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes entire codebases into a local SQLite knowledge graph. Ships with 13 brain tools for semantic search, call-graph traversal, AST-precise refactoring, architectural pattern detection, cross-language migration, and security scanning across 38 languages.
highlights: 13 brain tools (bb_search, bb_select, bb_refactor, bb_security, bb_migrate, bb_relationships, bb_patterns, bb_visualize, bb_ask, bb_update, bb_insert, bb_delete)
Offline semantic search with word vectors
Beats Copilot on compiler-level code reasoning — benchmarked against TypeScript (VS Code) and Roslyn codebases
